title: All-stage normalized Verdier exchange package
statement: Fix the global finite-field and coefficient data of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], including $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. For composable separated finite-type morphisms $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, fix normalized exceptional systems for $f,g,gf$ and compactifications of these maps. An all-stage Verdier exchange package consists of coefficient units and stage data of [def-sf-verdier-exchange-data] at every finite, integral, rational and common stage; their ring realizations and normalized projections; stage conclusions whose components equal the specified evaluation/projection transpose $\epsilon$; signed shift realizations; and the exchange naturality equation. It includes the integral compositor normalized against the actual completed compact-support compositor and its right-adjoint dualizing mate, ring scalar comparisons with their actual compact-support and unit realizations, rationalization comparisons, finite field-extension comparisons and common-stage comparisons, each with the dualizing-mate equation, exchange square and signed shifts and with exceptional comparisons equal to those of the fixed systems. Define the exchange assertion for $f:X\to Y$ by specializing $g=a_Y$, $Z=\operatorname{Spec}k$ with its identity structure map, and requiring a nonempty package for every choice of those normalized systems and compactifications. This defines the assertion and package; it does not prove or choose either.
